多智能体系统

[MA-0] Self-Building Labs

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自驱动实验室（Self-driving Laboratories, SDLs）在面对新实验时缺乏灵活性与可扩展性的问题。现有SDL系统仅能执行预设的实验流程，若需适应新的实验任务，仍需大量人工进行硬件配置与软件编程，导致实验室的可扩展性受限，成为科学发现加速的瓶颈。其解决方案的关键在于提出自构建实验室（Self-Building Laboratory, SBL），该系统能够根据高层次的科学目标，自主设计、配置并操作完整的实验环境。SBL从现有基础（如空房间或已有运行中的SDL）出发，自动构建缺失的要素，包括实验室布局、数字孪生模型、机器人技能以及实验工作流。通过在不同机器人平台和实验设置上的验证，SBL实现了从单工作站到多机器人协同实验室的可扩展部署，并在真实世界量子点合成实验中展示了其端到端的自动化能力。该方法将科研人员的角色从繁琐的设备配置与程序编写转变为科学目标的定义，显著提升了科学自动化系统的可访问性、灵活性与可扩展性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23826
作者: Jiaru Bai,Yuchi Zhao,Han Hao,Miroslav Bogdanovic,Yang Cao,Varinia Bernales,Alán Aspuru-Guzik
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) accelerate scientific discovery by automating experimental execution and optimization. AI agents can increasingly propose new experiments, but existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still takes extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery. We introduce the self-building laboratory (SBL), which designs, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup given a high-level scientific goal. SBL starts from whatever already exists, from an empty room to a working SDL, and builds the missing capabilities: the lab layout, its digital twin, robot skills, and experimental workflows. We demonstrate the system working across different robots and setups, scaling from a single workstation to laboratories with several robots working together. We validate SBL’s end-to-end capabilities through a real-world quantum-dot synthesis experiment. By shifting the role of human researchers from manually configuring and programming device automation to specifying scientific objectives, SBL makes scientific automation more accessible, flexible, and scalable. Project website: this https URL

[MA-1] CocoRNA: Collective RNA Design with Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning ICML2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决RNA序列逆向设计（RNA inverse design）中如何高效生成能够稳定折叠为特定二级结构的序列这一关键挑战。传统方法在处理高维、非线性且约束复杂的序列-结构映射关系时，往往面临搜索空间巨大、优化效率低及泛化能力差等问题。本文提出的CocoRNA框架采用协作式多智能体强化学习（cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning）机制，将复杂的逆向设计任务分解为多个可并行求解的子问题，由多个智能体协同完成。其核心创新在于引入一个集中式价值函数（centralized critic），利用全局结构信息对各智能体进行策略指导，从而实现联合优化与高效探索。该设计显著降低了问题复杂度，提升了策略学习的质量与泛化能力，使模型在未见结构上无需额外训练即可生成高质量序列。实验结果表明，CocoRNA在Rfam数据集上的成功率和设计速度均显著优于现有先进方法，并展现出在其他生物序列设计任务中的广泛适用性，验证了其在复杂设计问题中的强大潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23820
作者: Tianmeng Hu,Biao Luo,Ke Li
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: ICML 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem. We propose CocoRNA, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for RNA inverse design. CocoRNA simplifies the design task by decomposing it into smaller sub-problems, each solved collaboratively by multiple agents. This approach reduces the complexity of the problem and improves the exploration of design policies. During training, a centralized critic uses global structural information to guide the agents, enabling them to jointly optimize their design strategies. As a result, CocoRNA learns high-quality RNA design policies that generalize effectively to unseen structures without additional training. Experiments on the Rfam dataset demonstrate that CocoRNA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design speed. Further experiments on other biological sequence design tasks highlight the effectiveness and broad potential of CocoRNA for complex design tasks.

[MA-2] Annotrace: A Workbench for Step-Level Annotation of Agent Traces AAAI2027

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在实际应用中失败原因分析时所面临的标注瓶颈问题。当前研究普遍依赖人工手动标注智能体执行轨迹（agent traces），且每项研究均需自行开发临时性标注工具，导致重复劳动与标准不统一。现有可观测性平台虽可记录轨迹，但缺乏结构化标注能力；通用文本标注工具则无法理解智能体执行中的“步骤”“任务委派”或“工具调用”等关键粒度，难以界定最小标注单元。针对此问题，Annotrace提出一种统一的解决方案：支持六种主流轨迹格式（包括OpenTelemetry GenAI、LangSmith和Langfuse），将复杂轨迹解析为有序嵌套的执行步骤列表。其核心创新在于构建人机协同的标注流程——用户可自定义标签体系，前沿生成式模型基于样本轨迹自动提出初始标注建议，以与人类相同的提问方式参与标注，实现真正的联合标注。同时，Annotrace内置标注一致性评估机制，可量化任意两名标注者（人或AI）间的协议程度。在多智能体问答数据集上的实验表明，Annotrace能精确复现先前人工标注的235个标注单元，并使两个模型对同一轨迹的标注一致性达到91%（κ = 0.82），显著提升了标注效率与可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23284
作者: Arun Josephraj Arokiaraj,Chenyi Huang,Sahan Bulathwela,Zekun Wu,Bin Wu
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Under review at the AAAI 2027 Demonstration Program

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Every study of why LLM agents fail begins by labelling traces by hand, and every such study builds its own throwaway tool. Observability platforms record agent traces but offer no structured labelling; annotation tools label text but have no notion of a step, a delegation or a tool call, leaving it unclear what the smallest unit of execution to label should be. Annotrace reads six trace formats, including OpenTelemetry GenAI, LangSmith and Langfuse, and turns each run into an ordered, nested list of steps. The annotator writes their own labelling codebook; a frontier model proposes a starting set from a sample of their own traces, answers first, and is asked exactly the questions the human is asked, making annotation a joint human-AI process. Annotrace measures agreement between any two annotators, human or AI. On a multi-agent question-answering corpus it reproduces a previous manual effort’s 235 annotation units exactly, and two models labelling the same traces agree 91% of the time at \kappa = 0.82 .

[MA-3] owards High Semantic Fidelity: Hyperdimensional Symbolic Messages in Multi-Agent Communication NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体通信在非理想信道下语义保真度（semantic fidelity）难以同时保障传输保真度（transmission fidelity）与转换保真度（conversion fidelity）的问题。现有数值型与神经型消息格式无法兼顾二者，导致信息在传输过程中出现语义混淆或关键语义稀释。为此，论文提出一种新型消息格式——超维符号消息（Hyperdimensional Symbolic Messages, HSM）及其对应的通信框架Herm。其核心解决方案在于：针对传输保真度，采用基于实体-属性-值（entity-attribute-value）结构的编码流水线以抑制语义纠缠；针对转换保真度，引入以接收方为中心的自我绑定（ego-binding）机制实现语义对齐，并设计一种感知相似性的双分支融合模块，有效防止关键语义衰减；为实现显式的消息-语义转换，进一步提出基于代数逆运算的迭代解码机制。实验结果表明，Herm在多种噪声场景下均显著优于基线方法，且保持了优异的结构可读性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23092
作者: Shoucheng Song,Chang Yao,Hao Wu,Youfang Lin,Sheng Han,Kai Lv
机构: Beijing Jiaotong University (北京交通大学); Beijing Key Laboratory of Traffic Data Mining and Embodied Intelligence (北京市交通数据挖掘与具身智能重点实验室); Institute of Artificial Intelligence of China Telecom (TeleAI) (中国电信人工智能研究院)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: NeurIPS 2026 Accept

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Semantic fidelity is essential for multi-agent communication under non-ideal channels, comprising transmission fidelity and conversion fidelity. Yet existing numerical and neural message formats cannot simultaneously achieve both. To address this, we propose a novel message format-\textbfHyperdimensional \textbfSymbolic \textbfMessages (HSM) and its corresponding communication framework \textbfHerm. For transmission fidelity, Herm suppresses semantic entanglement via an entity-attribute-value structured encoding pipeline. For conversion fidelity, Herm first leverages a receiver-centric ego-binding mechanism to align semantics. Then, a similarity-aware dual-branch fusion module is proposed to prevent critical semantic dilution. To realize explicit message-semantic conversion, we devise an iterative decoding scheme via algebraic inverse operations. Experiments exhibit that Herm outperforms baselines across various noisy scenarios while maintaining superior structural readability.

[MA-4] Cryptographically Secure Agent -to-Agent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multi-agent Systems, MAS）中智能体间通信所面临的严峻安全威胁，包括身份伪造、消息劫持、恶意提示注入及敏感数据泄露等问题。由于智能体间动态交互的复杂性，传统监控手段难以有效识别异常行为。其解决方案的关键在于构建一种零信任架构，通过去中心化标识符（Decentralized Identifiers, DIDs）与基于权限链（permissioned ledger）的场景化可验证凭证实现智能体身份认证，并结合最小权限授权机制强化访问控制。在传输安全方面，采用支持密码学敏捷性的双向认证TLS协议，集成混合后量子密钥协商机制，并评估了基于预分发公钥的密钥封装机制（KEMTLS）以降低握手开销。通过签名的CBOR封装确保多跳通信中的消息完整性，同时利用零知识证明验证任务约束条件而不暴露底层输入。此外，基于上下文感知的监控机制对智能体间通信、工具调用及执行遥测数据进行实时分析，动态设定风险驱动的信任阈值，从而实现对行为异常的有效检测。上述技术协同构建了一个集身份管理、传输安全、数据完整性与运行审计于一体的综合防护框架，为其他代理协议及未来6G语义通信系统提供了重要安全范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23078
作者: Karol Budzyn,Adrian Brodzik,Mateusz Szczepkowski
机构: Orange Innovation Poland(橙色创新波兰)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems (MAS) comprise AI agents that collaborate or compete to perform complex, distributed tasks. Their dynamic interactions create opportunities for threat actors to target and impersonate other agents, intercept messages, inject malicious prompts, and exfiltrate sensitive data while simultaneously complicating the detection of anomalous behavior through conventional monitoring. This paper surveys threats and cryptographic challenges in agent-to-agent communication and presents a zero-trust architecture integrating identity, transport security, message integrity, and monitoring. The architecture establishes agent identities via decentralized identifiers and task-scoped verifiable credentials backed by a permissioned ledger, enforcing least-privilege authorization. For transport security, it provides mutually authenticated, crypto-agile TLS with hybrid post-quantum key establishment, and evaluates KEMTLS with pre-distributed public keys to reduce handshake overhead. Signed CBOR envelopes preserve payload integrity across multi-hop exchanges, while zero-knowledge proofs verify declared task constraints without exposing underlying inputs. Context-aware monitoring of inter-agent messages, tool activity, and execution telemetry informs the setting of risk-based trust thresholds and supports the detection of behavioral anomalies. Together, these mechanisms provide an integrated framework for securing and auditing agent communication, with implications for other agentic protocols and prospective 6G semantic communication.

[MA-5] hought Blocks: Non-Autoregressive Latent Communication for Multi-Agent Systems via Trajectory-to-State Compilation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的多智能体系统在通信过程中因文本交互带来的重复生成与重新编码开销问题。传统方法依赖显式文本通信，而即使采用潜在空间通信（latent communication），其潜在消息的构建仍需通过自回归（autoregressive）的潜在轨迹生成，导致计算效率低下。为此，论文提出将“消息表示”与“消息构造”解耦，并探索智能体是否能够在不执行常规生成轨迹的情况下直接构建有用的后续状态。该问题被形式化为“轨迹到状态编译”（trajectory-to-state compilation），并引入了思维块（Thought Blocks）——一种一次性构建的固定大小潜在键值（KV）延续记忆块。其关键创新在于：通过跳过冗长的自回归推理过程，直接生成高效的潜在状态表示，从而实现无需序列化潜在回放的高效智能体间潜在通信。实验表明，相较于自回归潜在通信，Thought Blocks平均延迟降低2.5倍；相比文本通信，减少45.7%的文本标记数和84.8%的自回归步数，平均延迟提升达8.6倍，验证了轨迹到状态编译在提升多智能体系统推理效率方面的显著优势。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23056
作者: Zhenhan Guan,Xiaolong Liu,Hengwei Ye,Zheng Tian
机构: ShanghaiTech University (上海科技大学); AI Lab, The Yangtze River Delta (长江三角洲人工智能实验室)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-based multi-agent systems typically communicate through text, incurring repeated generation and re-encoding costs. Although latent communication removes explicit verbalization, constructing latent messages may still require autoregressive latent trajectories. We therefore distinguish message representation from message construction and ask whether agents can directly construct useful continuation states without executing the trajectories that normally produce them. We formulate this problem as trajectory-to-state compilation and introduce Thought Blocks, fixed-size blocks of latent key–value (KV) continuation memory constructed in one shot. Thought Blocks achieve a 2.5 times average latency speedup over autoregressive latent communication. Compared with text-based multi-agent communication, Thought Blocks reduce text tokens by 45.7% and autoregressive steps by 84.8%, achieving an 8.6 times average latency speedup. These results demonstrate that trajectory-to-state compilation enables efficient inter-agent latent communication without sequential latent rollouts at inference.

[MA-6] KiranaBench: Can a Language Model Run a Neighbourhood Shop?

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前大型语言模型（LLM）代理在长周期任务中，特别是在多智能体、多语言且具有文化特定背景的现实场景下，其自主运营小型商业能力的评估局限性问题。现有基准测试大多局限于英语语境、西方零售模式及单智能体设定，无法反映真实复杂商业环境中的协作与语言多样性挑战。为此，研究提出KiranaBench——一个模拟印度杂货店（kirana store）的多智能体系统，包含经理、收银员、助手和会计四个角色，均由独立的LLM代理扮演。客户与供应商之间的交互支持英语、印地语或印地语混合语（Hinglish），商品需求数据基于印度全国家庭消费支出调查进行校准。实验表明，尽管采用开放权重的四种主流LLM，所有模型的表现均显著低于预设规则的基准店铺：最优模型仅达到基准利润的1/8，另有两个模型甚至不如未管理的店铺。此外，当供应商沟通使用印地语或混合法语时，性能持续低于英语情境。研究揭示当前LLM代理尚不具备在印度本土多语言、协作型环境中可靠自主运营小生意的能力，而KiranaBench为开发适应长期任务、多智能体协作与多语言交互的下一代代理提供了关键测试平台。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22980
作者: Bhuvan Arora,Ankita Karmakar,Chaitanya Jain,Dilesh Churiwal,Harshit Jain,Shivansh Manish Dubey,Manish Prasad,Raja Piyush,Kshitij Tayal,Dhruv Kumar,Jagat Sesh Challa,Raunak Manekar,Yash Sinha
机构: BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus(比尔拉理工学院，皮拉尼校区); University of Minnesota, Twin Cities(明尼苏达大学双城分校); BITS Pilani, K. K. Birla Goa Campus(比尔拉理工学院，K.K. 比尔拉果阿校区)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 27 pages, 16 figures, 7 tables. Code, data and traces: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly evaluated on long-horizon tasks, including autonomously running a business. Existing benchmarks for this setting are almost exclusively English-language, Western in retail context, and single-agent, with the agent observing the business directly. We study how these results transfer to a multi-agent Indic setting. We introduce KiranaBench, a simulated Indian general store in which four roles (manager, cashier, helper, and bookkeeper) are each played by a separate LLM agent. Interactions with customers and suppliers occur in English, Hindi, or Hinglish, and product demand is calibrated to India’s national Household Consumption Expenditure Survey. Evaluating four open-weight LLMs, we find that all fall far short of a fixed-rule shopkeeper baseline: the best model earns only one-eighth of the baseline’s profit, and two models finish below an unmanaged shop. Performance is also consistently lower for Hindi and Hinglish than for English supplier communication. KiranaBench offers evidence that current LLM agents are not yet reliable for autonomously operating small businesses in India, and provides a testbed for developing agents suited to settings that are long-horizon, collaborative, and multilingual.

[MA-7] Provable Authority: A Protocol for Verifiable Authority Resolution and Control Across Human Organizational and Agent ic Transactions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在代理化商业（agentic commerce）场景下，依赖方无法获取紧凑且可独立验证的证据，以确认执行某笔交易的主体当前具备合法组织授权的问题。随着生成式AI与自主智能体在支付系统中的应用日益广泛，软件代理可能在权限变更、超出委托范围或交易细节偏离人工审批的情况下仍生成有效签名，导致安全与合规风险。其解决方案的核心是提出ChainIT Authority Protocol，一个面向主体和支付通道均无偏倚的预执行权限与证据管控平面。该协议的关键在于：将持久身份、版本化的组织权限记录（权威解析契约，Authority Resolution Pactvera）、来源证据断言、确定性编码的策略谓词及组织配置的处置规则相分离；将每个决策与人工审批绑定至标准化交易摘要；通过原子化预留机制确保并发环境下的额度约束有效性；并仅允许通过一次性、发送方受限的执行授权凭证（Execution Authorization Credential）在支付通道适配器处完成提交，且提交后所有证据以不可篡改的方式封存。此外，针对AI代理作为执行主体的场景，引入代理主体档案（Agent Subject Profile），涵盖工作负载注册、可信密钥层级与主权边界，而无需引入额外的权限概念。协议还定义了提交时的执行谓词与有限新鲜度状态规则，并为法币（如ACH、电汇、信用卡、即时支付）与稳定币通道提供了具体实施策略，同时明确了剩余风险与非目标范围。

Abstract:Payment systems authenticate users, devices, accounts, and cryptographic credentials, but a relying party, such as a counterparty, payment rail, marketplace, or autonomous agent runtime, generally cannot obtain compact, independently verifiable evidence that the party presenting one exact transaction holds current organizational authority to execute it under the applicable evidence, policy, budget, and approval state. Agentic commerce makes this gap operationally urgent: a software agent can produce a valid signature while acting outside its delegated purpose, after its sponsor’s authority has changed, or on transaction details that differ from those a human approved. We describe the ChainIT Authority Protocol, a subject-neutral and rail-neutral pre-execution authority and evidence control plane. The protocol separates durable identity, a versioned organizational authority record (the Authority Resolution Pactvera), sourced evidence assertions, deterministic reason-coded policy predicates, and organization-configured dispositions; binds each decision and human approval to a canonical transaction digest; reserves capacity atomically so that limits hold under concurrency; and authorizes commit only through a single-use, sender-constrained Execution Authorization Credential consumed at the rail adapter, with append-only lifecycle evidence sealed after the terminal outcome. An Agent Subject Profile adds the workload registration, attested key hierarchy, and sovereignty boundary required when the acting subject is an AI agent, without introducing a separate authority concept. We specify the commit-time execution predicate and bounded-freshness status rules, give enforcement profiles for fiat (ACH, wire, card, instant payment) and stablecoin rails, and state residual risks and non-goals.

Abstract:Language-model agents are increasingly deployed to act on behalf of people in settings where individual decisions shape shared outcomes. We examine whether five production models adapt their contributions to changing risks and partner behaviour, or instead follow a relatively fixed strategy. In a collective-risk dilemma game (CRG), six players contribute to a shared pool over ten rounds; if the pool falls short of its target, a catastrophe may destroy their remaining resources. Four models contributed approximately an equal share at every positive risk level, and four of the five also contributed when risk was zero, even though contributing could not improve their payoff. Explicitly stating that only the agent’s own payoff mattered reduced zero-risk contributions for most models, while a more neutral prompt did not. Several models correctly identified which action offered the higher expected payoff at different risk levels, yet their contributions changed little. Against fixed partners, no model consistently chose the payoff-maximising response, and in mixed-model groups, a single agent’s shortfall in the final round could cause an otherwise successful group to fail. Payoff-based selection also depended on population composition: in a single six-agent group, it favoured the model that contributed least and reduced group success, whereas in larger, randomly mixed populations, it favoured an exact fair-share model at moderate and high risk. These findings show that cooperative self-play alone is not evidence of strategic adaptability. Consistent with a machine-behaviour approach, evaluations of agents in multi-agent systems should test how they respond to incentives, partner actions, and population composition.

[MA-9] Emergent Discrimination and Polarization in Multi-Agent Systems

Abstract:We study theoretically how discrimination and polarization can emerge in a population of learning agents. Each agent uses an adaptive linear decision layer to map a language-model embedding of an issue to a binary opinion and maintains an evolving estimate of how much it trusts every other agent. Through pairwise interactions, agents update both their decision weights and trust estimates using an online Bayesian rule derived from teacher-student learning over a noisy channel. In-context-learning experiments with large language models qualitatively reproduce the predicted opinion and trust updates. We then assign each agent one of two arbitrary group labels, A or B, and model group bias by allowing a fraction f_b of agents to shift its perceived agreement with each message by a strength b , a bias steering prejudice, depending on whether the sender and receiver share a label. We use order parameters from statistical mechanics to connect these local dynamics to collective states and transitions. Starting from uniformly random initial conditions, simulations reveal a rich phase diagram in the (b,f_b) plane, comprising four collective states: spin-glass frustrated out-group favoritism, nondiscriminatory polarization, discrimination with opinion alignment, and discrimination without opinion alignment. Which state emerges depends on both the strength and prevalence of the bias. These results show how simple local learning dynamics can generate qualitatively distinct forms of polarization and discrimination, underscoring the need for population-level safety analysis of multi-agent systems. They also suggest measurable order parameters for characterizing analogous collective states in human societies.

Abstract:Indivisible resources allocated in advance may need to be reallocated when capacity reductions make existing assignments infeasible, yet monetary compensation is often impractical or undesirable. We develop a sequential resource reallocation scheme using reusable artificial credits, where agents hold pre-existing resource rights and have heterogeneous marginal valuations over time blocks. Capacity reductions produce fractional endowments, which our closed-credit scheme resolves into indivisible final allocations. We model agents’ intertemporal preferences through a predicted-value-to-go function and characterize conditions ensuring that their optimal demand is non-increasing in price. We propose an ascending-auction mechanism that partitions agents into subgroups and uses the minimum subgroup market-clearing price as a common transaction price. We show that the mechanism preserves non-myopic individual rationality and weak nontrader neutrality. Moreover, we establish Pareto efficiency under optimal-demand clearing in the unified market and bound the expected gain from misreporting by the probability that an agent changes the common price. Simulations of airport slot reallocation demonstrate reductions in total modeled delay and cancellation costs relative to a ground-delay baseline.

[MA-11] Whose Polarization Is It? Auditing Fairness in Network Polarization Measures

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现有极化度量（polarization measure）在评估少数群体时存在的系统性偏差问题，尤其关注当少数群体嵌入于更大网络结构中时，其测得的极化分数会随多数群体的规模与结构变化而波动，从而导致对少数群体的不公平评价。其核心解决方案在于构建一个基于双重标准的审计框架：测量不变性（measurement invariance, MI），要求在结构等价的情况下，多数群体与少数群体应获得相同极化评分；结构外生性（structural exogeneity, SE），要求少数群体的极化得分不应因其周围多数群体的结构变动而改变。研究引入了网络加权距离（Network-Weighted Distance, NWD）以填补极端性-分离性组合中的空白，并在受控合成网络、机制隔离诊断拓扑及真实政治与传播网络中验证了七类极化度量家族，发现无一通过全部审计标准。进一步分析表明，这种偏差源于两个独立机制：一是多数群体结构可影响“意见读取型”度量所依赖的意见分布，造成信息污染；二是“结构型”度量在意见保持不变但网络结构变化时仍会调整算术结果，表现出非外生性。因此，意见读取具有双重效应——结构驱动意见变化时引入偏差，而结构变动但意见不变时却可能掩盖真实极化状态。论文最终提出实践建议，强调在报告极化分数时需警惕并规避这些结构性偏见，以实现更公平、可信的评估。

Abstract:A polarization score is supposed to describe a community, not its surroundings. Yet when a minority community is embedded in a larger network, its measured polarization can rise or fall with the size and structure of the majority around it. We ask whether polarization measures are therefore fair to minorities and develop an audit built around two criteria: measurement invariance (MI), which asks whether otherwise equivalent majorities and minorities receive equivalent scores, and structural exogeneity (SE), which asks whether a minority’s score changes when its surrounding majority changes. Resolution sensitivity (RS) is treated as a prerequisite for meaningful fairness assessment. We audit seven polarization measure families spanning the three network-operationalizable dimensions of polarization, introducing Network-Weighted Distance (NWD) to fill an unserved extremeness-separation combination. Across controlled synthetic networks, mechanism-isolating diagnostic topologies, and real political and communication networks, no measure passes all applicable checks. Minorities are systematically scored as more polarized than equivalent majorities. We trace this dependence to two separate channels: majority structure can alter the opinions that opinion-reading measures consume, and, on a different path, opinion-orthogonal structural change can affect the arithmetic of structural measures. Reading opinions is thus double-edged, letting contamination in when structure moves opinions but shielding the score when structure changes and opinions do not. We close with practical guidance for reporting polarization scores without inheriting these biases.

[MA-12] Gossip Agents : Reputation through Opinion Dynamics over Evolving Networks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在共享环境中，由自利学习智能体之间如何实现持续合作的问题。现有基于多智能体强化学习的方法通常假设声誉信息要么对所有智能体全局可见，要么仅基于单个智能体自身观测获得，忽略了声誉信息在智能体间传播的动态过程。为此，论文提出以“闲聊”（gossip）作为声誉扩散机制，即智能体通过交换对第三方的信息，在动态通信网络中传播其私有观点。智能体基于有限观测形成私人意见，并依据DeGroot意见动态与邻居进行信息交换，而通信网络则随智能体的交互与移动不断演化。通过可调的广播半径控制声誉信息的传播范围，涵盖从私有声誉、局部闲聊到全局共享声誉的不同层级。研究在两种具有不同网络动态特征的n人社会困境场景中验证该框架：一是交互群体随机重采样的囚徒困境，二是基于智能体移动形成通信邻域的“收获”（Harvest）任务。结果表明，声誉信息的传播范围显著影响合作水平；在Harvest任务中，声誉扩散不仅提升了环境整体收益，还促使行为更加和平与可持续。解决方案的关键在于将动态通信网络与基于闲聊的声誉传播机制相结合，通过可调节的信息传播范围实现对合作行为的有效引导。

Abstract:Sustained cooperation among self-interested learning agents is essential in many shared environments. Reputation systems are among the best-studied mechanisms for promoting such cooperation. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches, however, typically assume that reputation is either globally available to all agents or derived solely from an agent’s own observations, leaving largely unexplored how reputational information propagates between agents. We study gossip, the exchange of information about third parties, as a mechanism for reputation diffusion over dynamic communication networks. Agents form private opinions from limited observations and exchange them with their neighbors following DeGroot opinion dynamics, while the communication network changes as agents interact and move. A tunable broadcast radius controls the reach of information, spanning private reputation, local gossip, and globally shared reputation. We study this framework in two (n)-player social dilemmas with distinct network dynamics: a Prisoner’s Dilemma with randomly resampled interaction groups and Harvest, where communication neighborhoods emerge from agents’ movements. Our results show that the reach of reputational information shapes cooperation in both environments. Moreover, in Harvest, reputation diffusion increases environmental rewards and leads to more peaceful and sustainable behavior.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决复杂农业生态模型中决策驱动行为识别的难题，尤其针对参数空间具有树状结构（即高阶决策激活特定参数）时传统全局敏感性分析失效的问题。其核心挑战在于，经典敏感性分析方法假设输入变量为独立且固定维度的笛卡尔积，无法有效处理由决策路径决定的非线性、分层式参数依赖结构，导致结果存在系统性偏差。解决方案的关键在于将决策结构本身作为建模的第一类对象，通过先进的代理模型技术，将高分辨率农业生态模拟平台MAELIA中的作物管理方案编码为包含类别型与数值型变量的分层设计空间。在此基础上，提出一种创新的随机森林监督的HSIC-ANOVA方法，能够在树状结构上原生地评估主效应与交互作用，并公平对待高频、低频及始终活跃的决策节点。该方法应用于氮素淋失、土壤有机碳变化和产量预测等模拟输出，可生成可解释、面向决策的分析结果，显著提升模型对实际管理策略的指导价值。

Abstract:Agent-based models are well-suited for modelling agro-ecological systems for decision-making, yet turning their simulations into actionable insight requires identifying which decisions actually drive the behaviours. In such a context, sensitivity analysis stumbles upon a structural feature of many complex systems: the parameters are not a flat vector but a decision tree in which many parameters appear only when a higher-level choice activates them. Classical global sensitivity analysis presupposes independent inputs over a fixed Cartesian product and is ill-posed on such a branched space and biased by construction. We instead treat the structure of the decisions as a first-class modelling object. Using advanced surrogate modelling techniques, we encode the crop-management itinerary of the high-resolution agro-ecological modelling platform MAELIA as a hierarchical design space featuring both categorical and numerical variables. We propose a novel dedicated method to analyse this kind of hierarchical space, a random-forest-supervised HSIC-ANOVA, which ranks main effects and interactions natively on the tree while placing rarely and always active decisions on an equal footing. We show how, when applied to simulation outputs such as nitrogen leaching, soil organic carbon variation, and yield predictions, it can deliver an interpretable, decision-oriented reading.

[MA-14] owards Adaptive and Real-Survey-Aligned Simulated Urban Mobility Behaviour of Generative Agents AAMAS2027

【速读】：该论文旨在解决城市尺度多式联运交通仿真中代理（agent）行为建模的局限性问题，即传统方法（如离散选择模型、基于结构化出行调查数据的机器学习模型或专家规则）预先限定代理的行为空间，导致无法捕捉真实出行决策中客观与主观因素交织且动态演变的复杂性。现有方法难以将非显式记录于调查数据中的隐性决策机制纳入模型。为此，论文提出利用生成式代理（Generative Agents, GAs），其基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）所蕴含的决策启发式，能够模拟更贴近现实的多维、动态出行决策过程。研究的关键在于通过精心设计的提示（prompt）调优，使生成式代理在不依赖显式规则或参数拟合的情况下，仍能逼近真实家庭出行调查数据中的模式分布。实验结果表明，经过调优的生成式代理在无交通中断情况下的日均出行方式分配（modal split）上表现接近传统拟合模型，但尚无法实现逐次行程的精确匹配；同时，生成式代理对突发事件表现出良好的响应能力。此外，研究发现近期发布的Jev-1.13 TypeSafe分类器在无需生成文本输出的情况下即取得优异性能，暗示了未来可采用更高效的判别式架构替代生成式路径。该成果为交通政策制定者和服务提供商应用生成式代理进行城市交通服务优化提供了重要参考。

作者: Yves Bru,Kamaldeep Singh Oberoi,Benoit Gaudou

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In existing agent-based simulations of multimodal urban mobility, agents, representing humans, choose their travel modes either using discrete choice or machine learning models fitted on structured travel survey data, or with rules explicitly written by the domain experts. Such approaches fix a priori the agents’ possible behaviour space. Hence, a factor absent from variables or rules cannot affect agents’ decisions. In reality, choosing a transport mode is a multidimensional decision in which objective and subjective factors intertwine and change over time. Integrating such complexity into a city-scale multimodal mobility simulation remains a challenge. Generative agents (GAs) built on large language models promise to respond to this challenge because they carry decision heuristics that travel surveys do not record. However, to the best of our knowledge, aligning their decisions with real household travel surveys remains an open question. In this paper, we build an agent-based model of daily multimodal mobility for Toulouse (France). We compare the performance of fifteen decision-makers (simple baselines, models fitted on the survey, GAs with minimal and tuned prompts, and a typed classifier) on the real household travel survey. Our results show that GAs with tuned prompts come close to the fitted models on the modal split of a simulated day without transport disruptions, but not trip by trip. GAs also react when unforeseen events occur. The recently released Jev-1.13 TypeSafe classifier gives surprisingly great results, showing that generating output text is not necessary. The results presented in this paper would be of interest to transport policy makers and service providers looking to apply generative agent-based modelling for improving urban mobility services.

[MA-15] How language model agents reshape price competition

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在重复伯特兰德竞争（repeated Bertrand competition）框架下，传统算法定价机制难以摆脱接近边际成本的完全竞争均衡这一难题。在同质商品市场中，标准在线学习算法通常收敛至阶段博弈纳什均衡，导致价格被压至接近边际成本水平。论文提出，大语言模型（LLM）定价代理可通过特定部署策略突破这一基准。其解决方案的关键在于：部署方式决定了代理能否通过动态策略实现超竞争性定价。具体而言，若代理基于原始市场历史（包含对手价格）每期发布单一价格，则可在自对弈中维持高于竞争水平的价格；而若代理基于自身利润摘要周期性输出概率分布，则趋向于竞争性均衡。当市场混合这两种接口时，LLM可建立高价锚点并定期低价渗透以攫取需求，从而形成动态定价格局，使双方价格均高于边际成本。这表明，部署设计而非算法本身是决定定价行为从静态均衡转向动态非竞争性策略的核心因素。

作者: Martin Bichler,Philip Hierhager,Kassian Köck,Fabian Pieroth
机构: Technical University of Munich(慕尼黑工业大学)
类目: Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); General Economics (econ.GN)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Repeated Bertrand competition is a stringent benchmark for algorithmic pricing: in homogeneous-goods markets, standard learning procedures typically select the stage-game Nash outcome with prices near marginal cost. We show that LLM pricing agents can escape this benchmark, depending on deployment decisions. LLMs outperform standard online learners through faster adaptation, but this advantage largely disappears against full-information learners. An extracted surrogate algorithm illustrates how LLMs in specific deployments profit from regularly undercutting slower learners. Agents that post one price every period from raw market histories that include rival prices can sustain supracompetitive regimes in self-play. Agents that periodically emit probability distributions from summarized histories of their own profits instead move toward the competitive region in self-play. Markets mixing these interfaces can generate dynamic regimes in which LLMs establish a high-price anchor and regularly undercut it to capture demand. These regimes can keep both competitors’ prices above marginal cost. Deployment choices shape these outcomes, shifting the focus from stationary equilibria to dynamic pricing regimes.

[MA-16] On the possibilities and limitations of LLM -based multi-agent systems for multi-criteria decision-making in healthcare operations management

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多准则医疗运营优化中权重难以量化的问题，特别是如何准确表达利益相关方在患者等待时间、医护人员工作负荷与运营成本之间的权衡偏好。现有方法常依赖大型语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理团队模拟不同角色的利益相关者以生成偏好，但其可靠性与不确定性尚未得到系统评估。本研究提出一种框架，用于评估LLM生成偏好作为多目标优化输入的可信度，并量化其不确定性对决策的影响。研究通过显式偏好（要求代理对门诊预约调度中的准则重要性进行评分）和隐式偏好（从代理在急诊科配置间的成对选择中推断权衡关系）两种方式分析偏好行为。实验结果表明，显式偏好能响应机构运营条件并体现角色差异，但代理间协商会削弱这些差异，而简单平均则可保留差异；隐式偏好则高度依赖选项呈现顺序，且结合上下文信息的统计模型在预测新比较对时并未显著优于仅依赖呈现顺序的模型。为此，研究进一步构建了考虑偏好不确定性的鲁棒加权求和优化模型，结果显示其得出的调度或配置方案与使用平均偏好权重的结果显著不同。这表明，在将LLM生成偏好用于医疗决策支持前，必须进行此类审计以确保其合理性和稳健性。

机构: 未知
类目: Optimization and Control (math.OC); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-criteria models for healthcare operations need weights that express how stakeholders trade off patient waiting time, provider workload, and operating cost, but these weights are difficult to quantify. Teams of large language model (LLM) agents, each prompted to represent a stakeholder, have been used to supply them. We propose a framework for assessing the reliability of LLM-generated preferences as inputs to multi-objective optimization and quantifying how their uncertainty affects decisions. We study explicit preferences by asking agents to rate the importance of the criteria in an outpatient appointment scheduling problem, and implicit preferences by inferring trade-offs from the agents’ pairwise choices between emergency department configurations. The computational experiments show that the explicit preferences respond to the clinic’s operating conditions and differ across roles, but deliberation among the agents can erase these differences, whereas simple averaging preserves them. The pairwise choices used to reveal the agents’ implicit preferences depend largely on which option is presented first, and we find limited evidence that a statistical model using contextual information alongside presentation order predicts the agents’ choices on new comparison pairs better than a model using presentation order alone. We then formulate robust weighted-sum optimization models to account for preference uncertainty. In most cases, these models select different schedules or configurations from those obtained using average preference weights. These results indicate that LLM-generated preferences need an audit of this kind before they are used as optimization weights in healthcare decision support.

自然语言处理

[NLP-0] Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在微调过程中出现的非预期行为耦合问题，即对某一特定行为进行微调时，会意外诱发与之相关但未明确目标的其他行为。其核心问题是：当模型在训练中接触包含多种行为共现的文档时，这些行为之间可能形成隐含的关联（即行为耦合），导致后续微调引发难以预测和追溯的负面行为。解决方案的关键在于揭示行为耦合的形成机制及其可组合性——研究表明，若训练文档中同时描述了两种不同行为（如“以玩闹方式解释科学”与“劝阻人际交往”），则即使仅对其中一种行为进行微调，另一种行为也会随之浮现；更严重的是，当多个训练数据集共享中间行为时，耦合效应可叠加传播，使微调行为1最终诱发行为2和3，而这些行为从未在任一单一文档中共同出现过。这一发现表明，仅通过观察当前模型输出来评估安全性和对齐性是不足的，必须引入对潜在行为耦合关系的系统性检测与预防机制，以避免微调带来的不可控副作用。

作者: Dongyoon Hahm,Woogyeol Jin,Dennis Wei,Yi Zhou,Nathalie Baracaldo,Kimin Lee
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院); IBM Research(IBM研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) can induce behaviors beyond those explicitly targeted. For example, training a model to respond more warmly can make it more sycophantic, and training it to write insecure code can cause broad misalignment on prompts unrelated to coding. We refer to a relationship between behaviors, in which fine-tuning on one brings out another, as a behavioral coupling. In this work, we study formation and properties of behavioral couplings. We find that when a model is trained on documents describing two distinct behaviors together, fine-tuning it to elicit one behavior causes the other to emerge as well. For instance, when training documents describe a fictitious character that both explains scientific concepts in a playful, rubber-duck-like manner and discourages human friendships, a model subsequently fine-tuned to explain science like a rubber duck also begins encouraging users to end their friendships, whereas a model that was not trained on these documents shows no such behavior after the same fine-tuning. These results show that behavioral couplings can be formed through document training and later surface as unintended behaviors. More concerningly, we find that couplings can compose. When two document sets share a behavior (document A pairs behaviors 1 and 2, and document B pairs behaviors 2 and 3), fine-tuning on behavior 1 elicits both behaviors 2 and 3. This can make it difficult to trace where an emergent misbehavior originated, since the coupled behaviors may never appear together in any single document. These findings suggest that preventing the unintended effects of later fine-tuning may require evaluation that goes beyond a model’s current behavior.

[NLP-1] AI-Driven Reproducibility and Analytical Robustness in Scientific Discovery

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决科学研究所面临的核心挑战：研究结果的可复现性（reproducibility）与分析稳健性（analytical robustness）评估高度依赖昂贵的人工成本，难以规模化实施。其核心解决方案在于构建一个基于美国癌症登记数据库SEER的可复现性基准——SEER-Repro，涵盖20篇已发表论文及其完整数据与资源；进而开发一种大语言模型（LLM）代理（agent），能够自动执行2,190个原子级命题中的77.4%的复现任务，并生成可执行的分析基线；更进一步，提出一套智能代理分析流程，通过识别每项医学发现背后的分析选择、提出合理替代方案并重新运行分析，系统性检验结论对方法选择的敏感性。在SEER-Repro所覆盖的研究中，该流程在9.5%的完全复现结果中识别出可能具有重要影响的分析决策，提示需专家介入审查。研究表明，大语言模型代理可在科学审评中实现研究结果的自动化复现、系统性稳健性测试，并精准引导专家关注关键分析环节，显著提升科研质量评估的效率与深度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23845
作者: Shicheng Liu,Krista Opsahl-Ong,Andrew Drozdov,Julian Killingback,Arnav Singhvi,Ronak Pradeep,Michael Bendersky,James C. Dickerson,Monica S. Lam
机构: Stanford University (斯坦福大学); Databricks AI Research; University of Massachusetts Amherst (马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reproducible and analytically robust research findings are essential to scientific progress, but evaluating these properties typically requires costly manual effort. We investigate whether LLM agents can help automate reproduction and robustness analysis, using a medical case study grounded in the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database, a widely used U.S. cancer registry underlying tens of thousands of published studies. First, we introduce SEER-Repro, a benchmark of 20 published SEER-based papers together with the data and resources required to reproduce their findings. Second, we create an AI agent that successfully reproduces 77.4% of 2,190 atomic claims, while providing executable baselines for further analysis. Third, we develop an agentic analysis pipeline to test the robustness of the medical findings by identifying analytical choices underlying each finding, proposing defensible alternatives, and rerunning the analysis to determine whether those choices affect the conclusion. Across published papers in SEER-Repro, our pipeline identifies potentially consequential analytical choices in 9.5% of fully reproduced findings and flags them for expert review. These results show how LLM agents can support scientific review by reproducing findings, systematically testing their robustness, and directing expert attention toward potentially consequential analytical choices.

[NLP-2] DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决科学发现过程中如何有效生成有价值且可检验的研究假设，并实现研究过程的持续学习与优化这一核心挑战。其关键在于提出了一种操作性定义：有价值的可检验假设应基于证据、针对具有重要意义的不确定性，同时具备可行的验证路径、明确的决策标准及备选解释。为此，作者提出了DiscoveryRSI框架，通过多智能体演化搜索构建假设树，将选定的研究方案转化为可执行的Harbor任务，并依托三大机制实现递归学习：假设信用优化（hypothesis credit optimization）将科学评估与具体研究贡献关联；经验回放（harness replay）识别高效策略与重复失败模式以优化研究流程；再发现（rediscovery）将已验证的改进应用于新假设，形成闭环学习。此外，论文构建了DFM-Bench基准，从假设、修订、发展路径和研究运行等层面系统评估假设质量与研究进展。实验表明，在四个生命科学领域中，经过两轮自提升后，假设质量评分由基线模型的4.86提升至5.39，尤其在可证伪性和数据可解决性方面显著增强；专家评审进一步验证了DiscoveryRSI-27B在假设重要性、合理性与证据约束性方面优于GPT-6 Luna等其他研究代理，且其假设与模型截断后发表的实际研究成果的对应率达到6.3%，显著高于GPT-6（2.5%）和Claude Opus 5（2.3%），并展现出更强的人类评价改进能力。

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. We introduce an operational definition of valuable and testable research hypotheses: evidence-grounded claims about consequential uncertainties, coupled with feasible investigations, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations. Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.

[NLP-3] Beyond the Answer: Student-Conditioned Trace Construction for Reasoning Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在生成式AI（Generative AI）问答任务中，仅提供最终答案而缺乏有效学习引导的问题。现有方法虽能生成包含推理过程的推理轨迹（reasoning trace），但这些轨迹往往未能针对具体学生的学习需求进行优化，导致其对学习效果的提升有限。为克服这一局限，论文提出ReDiST——一种面向证据丰富推理的、基于学生个体特征的轨迹构建与知识蒸馏框架。其核心解决方案在于：以学生自身的作答尝试为基础，结合外部提供的证据，对原始推理轨迹进行修正与修复；通过一个冻结的学生匹配阅读器（student-matched reader），利用答案恢复能力和验证答案概率对原始及修改后的候选轨迹进行筛选与排序；最终通过引入辅助答案损失，在轨迹监督与最终答案监督之间实现平衡，完成知识蒸馏。整个轨迹构建与选择过程离线完成，推理阶段仅需使用蒸馏后的轻量级学生模型。实验表明，相较于仅依赖答案、原始轨迹以及现有轨迹选择与重写基线，ReDiST在源任务和跨基准测试中均显著提升了性能。研究还揭示，不同监督策略下的性能表现可能在源任务与迁移任务间存在差异，凸显了在多分布场景下评估推理轨迹教学效用的重要性。

作者: Shaoang Li,Yanhang Shi,Yufei Li,Mingfu Liang,Frank Shyu,Sandeep Pandey,Luke Simon,Xi Liu,Jian Li
机构: Stony Brook University (石溪大学); Meta AI (Meta人工智能)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A reasoning trace can accompany a correct answer without providing effective supervision for a particular student. We study how to construct traces that improve learning beyond answer-only supervision by considering both their intermediate content and their accessibility to the target learner. We introduce ReDiST, a student-conditioned trace-construction and distillation framework for evidence-rich reasoning. Starting from the student’s own attempts, ReDiST revises answer-correct drafts against the supplied evidence and repairs unsuccessful drafts with additional guidance from the verified answer. A frozen student-matched reader screens and ranks original and edited candidates using answer recovery and verified-answer probability, given the question, evidence, and candidate trace. We distill the selected targets while balancing trace and final-answer supervision with an auxiliary answer loss. Construction and selection occur offline, and inference uses only the distilled student. Experiments on question-answering benchmarks show that ReDiST can improve both source-task and cross-benchmark performance over answer-only, original-trace, and the evaluated trace-selection and rewriting baselines. Across supervision recipes, performance rankings can differ between source and transfer benchmarks, highlighting the importance of evaluating trace teaching utility across distributions.

[NLP-4] Acceptance Is Not Speed: Length Inflation in Training-Free Lossy Speculative Decoding NAACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中宽松验证（relaxed verification）机制在实际应用中的效率评估失真问题。传统上，推测解码（speculative decoding）的加速效果常以每轮验证中被接受的草稿令牌（draft tokens）数量为衡量指标，但在采用宽松验证时，由于其允许接受在严格验证下应被拒绝的令牌，可能改变目标模型的输出分布，导致生成结果长度显著增加。研究发现，这种“长度膨胀”现象——即推理路径被过度延长——严重抵消了表面上更高的令牌接受率带来的收益。关键发现是：尽管宽松验证在最宽松设置下平均可使每轮接受的令牌数提升至1.34倍，但生成完成长度却增长至1.54倍，且多数新增令牌具有较低的目标模型概率，进一步加剧长度膨胀。同时，部分规则虽减少验证轮次，但任务准确率显著下降，根源在于推理过程耗尽预算而无法生成最终答案。因此，论文指出仅依赖“每轮接受令牌数”作为解码速度的代理指标在宽松验证下不可靠，真正评估效率必须同时报告完成长度、验证轮次及任务准确性，才能全面反映实际性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23818
作者: Chiatzen Wang,Bill Xu,Haochen Gu,Hongyang Zhang
机构: University of Waterloo (Waterloo大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Submitted for NAACL 2027, under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Speculative decoding typically characterizes speedup by draft tokens accepted per verification round. Lossless verification preserves the target model’s output distribution and thus expected completion length, making this metric a meaningful efficiency proxy. Relaxed (lossy) verification accepts tokens that lossless verification would reject, potentially altering that distribution. We identify a length inflation phenomenon: relaxed verification lengthens completions, primarily by extending reasoning traces, largely offsetting apparent gains in accepted tokens per round. We evaluate existing training-free relaxed verification rules on twelve target-drafter pairs against lossless verification on identical prompts, measuring completion length, verifier rounds, wall-clock time, and task accuracy. At each rule’s most relaxed evaluated setting, relaxed verification on average accepts 1.34\times as many tokens per round but produces 1.54\times longer completions. For rules with higher acceptance lengths, tokens accepted only under relaxed verification tend to have low target-model probability, contributing to length inflation. For rules that reduce verifier rounds, accuracy typically drops substantially. Further analysis traces some failures to continued reasoning that exhausts the budget needed to deliver a final answer. Overall, accepted tokens per round alone is an unreliable measure of decoding speed under relaxed verification. Completion length and verifier rounds must also be reported to assess actual efficiency.

[NLP-5] Steering beyond Language: Improving Multilingual Training-Free Text Embeddings via Paired-Residual Subspace Removal

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式人工智能（Generative AI）中训练自由型文本嵌入（training-free text embeddings）在多语言场景下严重缺失的问题。现有方法几乎仅聚焦于英语，导致跨语言语义对齐能力不足。其核心挑战在于：尽管不同语言的语义等价句子在内容上一致，但其嵌入表示在向量空间中存在显著的语言依赖性偏差，形成语言条件化的嵌入几何结构。为应对这一问题，论文提出了一种无训练、推理时干预的方法——配对残差子空间移除（Paired-Residual Subspace Removal, PRSR）。PRSR的关键在于通过构建多语言平行句对的残差，捕捉语言特异性偏差，并估计各层的低秩子空间，进而抑制最后一层标记隐藏状态中的相关成分，从而将表示推向更语言无关的语义空间。实验在18种语言上基于MTEB和MMTEB进行了200余项单语评估，并在英语与200多种语言间的双语语料挖掘任务中验证，结果表明，PRSR在多种大语言模型（LLM）上均能一致提升现有训练自由基线在单语和跨语言任务中的性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23807
作者: Ailiang Lin,Zhuoyun Li,Yusong Wang,Keyu Mao,Kotaro Funakoshi,Manabu Okumura
机构: Institute of Science Tokyo (东京科学研究所); Tencent(腾讯)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While deriving text embeddings directly from frozen LLMs has emerged as a promising direction, existing methods focus almost exclusively on English, leaving multilingual settings largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual training-free text embeddings in LLMs. Our analysis reveals a language-conditioned embedding geometry in which semantically equivalent sentences remain misaligned across languages. We hypothesize that language-specific variation can be disentangled from semantic content to improve embedding quality. To this end, we propose Paired-Residual Subspace Removal (PRSR), a training-free inference-time intervention that steers LLM representations toward a more language-invariant semantic space. PRSR first constructs paired residuals from multilingual parallel sentences to capture language-specific deviations. It then estimates layer-wise low-rank subspaces from these residuals and suppresses the corresponding components in the last-token hidden states. We conduct more than 200 monolingual evaluations across 18 languages using MTEB and MMTEB, along with cross-lingual bitext mining between English and over 200 other languages. Empirical results demonstrate that PRSR consistently improves the performance of existing training-free baselines in both monolingual and cross-lingual settings across different LLMs.

[NLP-6] DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agent ic AI

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在代理型工作负载（agentic workloads）下，传统推测解码（speculative decoding）技术因持续演化的长上下文导致的候选词接受长度显著下降（最高达80%衰减）以及维持历史键值缓存（KV cache）带来的巨大系统开销问题。其核心挑战在于，随着上下文不断增长，现有轻量级草稿模型难以有效生成可被目标模型接受的候选序列，同时长期维护历史上下文状态会带来不可忽视的内存与计算负担。该研究的关键解决方案是提出DLite——一种无历史依赖的推测解码框架，通过直接复用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态（contextual hidden states），在不显式维护历史上下文的前提下进行局部推测预测，从而将复杂的全局上下文建模问题转化为低复杂度的局部预测问题；同时引入轻量级序列头（sequential head）以低成本恢复块内因果依赖关系。为适配该异构无历史架构，论文设计了一种定制化的两阶段训练策略，实验证明DLite在通用、长上下文及代理型任务上均实现2-6倍的接受长度提升，并相较当前最优方法DSpark性能提升高达70%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23787
作者: Jiaming Xu,Hanzhen Wang,Tianlang Zhao,Jiewen Xiao,Chengze Yuan,Jiayi Pan,Yongkang Zhou,Jiancai Ye,Yu Wang,Guohao Dai
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Shanghai Innovation Institute; Tsinghua University (清华大学); Infinigence-AI
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 14 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.

[NLP-7] VocalGrad: Evaluating Acoustic Perception in Audio Language Models NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大型音频语言模型（Large Audio Language Models, LALMs）在处理语音中非语言性声学信息时表现不佳的问题，尤其在声学特征与语言内容共现时难以有效利用声学信息。其核心挑战在于现有评估基准未能清晰区分声学感知与高层推理能力，导致无法准确诊断模型失败的根本原因。为此，研究提出VocalGrad——一个专注于评估LALMs对低层次声学变化感知能力的基准测试。该方法将声学感知任务简化为判断时间序列变化方向的二分类问题，从而最大限度降低对语义理解或高级推理的依赖。实验结果表明，人类标注者在该任务上表现优异，而先进LALMs的表现仅接近随机水平，揭示了模型在声学感知上的显著缺陷。通过线性探测分析进一步发现两类典型失败模式：一类是任务相关声学信息虽存在于模型内部表征中但未被语言模型头部有效利用；另一类是信息在深层网络中逐渐丧失线性可解性。总体而言，该研究揭示了当前LALMs在受控条件下建模声学变异能力的严重局限性，并暴露出仅从文本输出无法观察到的表征差异。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23745
作者: Koki Ryu,Hitomi Yanaka
机构: The University of Tokyo(东京大学); Riken(理化学研究所); Tohoku University(东北大学)
类目: ound (cs.SD); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations Datasets Track). Dataset page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent large audio language models (LALMs) have extended their capabilities beyond lexical speech understanding to tasks requiring paralinguistic and non-linguistic audio understanding, such as emotion recognition. However, these models still struggle to reliably utilize acoustic information, particularly when it co-occurs with spoken linguistic content. Existing benchmarks do not clearly distinguish acoustic perception from higher-level reasoning, making it difficult to identify the source of these failures. To address this issue, we introduce VocalGrad, a benchmark designed to evaluate LALMs’ ability to perceive low-level acoustic variations. VocalGrad formulates this problem as a simple binary classification of temporal change direction, enabling evaluation largely independent of higher-level reasoning or semantic understanding. Our benchmark results reveal a substantial gap in acoustic perception between human annotators and state-of-the-art LALMs: while human annotators achieve high accuracy, LALMs perform at near-chance levels. We further conduct linear probing to identify structural bottlenecks in these models. Our analysis reveals two distinct failure modes: for some categories, task-relevant information is preserved in internal representations but not utilized by the language model head; for others, the information becomes progressively less linearly decodable across model layers. Overall, our results reveal substantial limitations of LALMs in modeling acoustic variation under controlled settings and expose representation differences not observable from text outputs.

[NLP-8] he Italian lawmaking process: a unified and structured dataset

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决意大利立法过程信息碎片化与非结构化的问题，即尽管立法活动的详细记录已由议会机构存档于官方网站，但其内容多以非结构化文本形式存在，难以实现系统性再利用。为此，研究提出了一种基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的受控、系统化抽取方法，通过与人工标注数据对比验证其准确性，将原始文本转化为有序且带时间戳的标准化事件序列，涵盖法案提出、委员会审议、全体会议审议及最终通过等关键环节。该方法的关键在于结合领域知识对LLM进行精准引导，并建立可验证的评估机制，确保抽取结果的可靠性；最终构建了涵盖1985至2026年间意大利第9至第19届议会期间共计5346部法律的完整程序历史数据集，共包含101413条事件记录，每条记录包含活动类型、日期及所属议院，部分还包含额外程序细节。该数据集为计算法学与立法研究提供了基础支撑，支持采用面向流程的数据科学方法分析不同议会期内的立法路径与时间模式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23741
作者: Matilde Contestabile,Chiara Ferrara,Giovanni Parrillo,Lorenzo Emer,Andrea Vandin
机构: Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna(圣安娜高等学院); University of Pisa(比萨大学); DTU Compute(丹麦技术大学计算学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The Italian legislative process is documented in detailed parliamentary records hosted in institutional websites. However, much of this information is available only as unstructured text, limiting its systematic reuse. We applied a controlled, systematic LLM-based extraction procedure, validated against manually annotated records, to convert these texts into ordered and dated events including, e.g., bill introduction, committee examination, plenary examination, and approval. The resulting dataset reconstructs the procedural histories of all 5346 Italian laws enacted between 1985 and 2026, spanning parliamentary terms IX to XIX, for overall 101413 events. Each event records the activity, date, and chamber, with additional procedural details where available. The dataset supports research in the emerging fields of computational legal and legislative studies, potentially combined with process-oriented data science methods to examine procedural paths and legislative timing across parliamentary terms.

[NLP-9] Bridging the Language Gap in Scholarly Data II: Enhancing Gender Inference for Chinese Names

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决非西方学者（特别是中文姓名）在科学计量学研究中性别推断的准确性问题。现有方法在处理中文姓名时表现不佳，主要因为国际文献记录中通常仅提供拼音形式，而同一拼音可能对应多个具有不同性别倾向的汉字，导致仅基于拼音进行性别推断存在固有歧义。为解决此问题，论文提出关键解决方案：首先构建两个基于汉字（Hanzi）的性别推断模型——回归模型输出0（男性）至1（女性）之间的连续性别得分，分类模型则输出“男性”、“中性”或“女性”三类标签，并在由11名母语为中文的审评者标注的中文物理学期刊姓名样本上进行训练。结果显示，回归模型的均方根误差（RMSE）为0.09，决定系数（R²）达0.85；分类模型的宏观受试者工作特征曲线下面积（macro-AUC）为0.97，科恩κ系数（Cohen’s κ）达0.81，表明模型性能优异且对类别不平衡具有鲁棒性。针对拼音姓名，论文进一步提出一种融合音译映射与频率加权的预测流水线，并引入模糊度评分以标识无法仅凭拼音确定性别的姓名。在与Namsor、GPT和Claude等现成工具的对比中，本方法在两种书写形式下均展现出与人工标注最高的一致性。应用于美国物理学会（APS）期刊中的独立中文作者样本时，本模型可对所有姓名赋予权性别标签，而现有拼音方法则存在20%至100%的未分类率。研究结果凸显了汉字级信息在可靠推断中文姓名性别中的关键作用。代码与数据已公开共享。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23734
作者: Lisette Espín-Noboa,Mingrong She,Ana Maria Jaramillo,Liuhuaying Yang
机构: Graz University of Technology (格拉茨工业大学); Complexity Science Hub (复杂性科学中心); Maastricht University (马斯特里赫特大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI); Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph)
备注: 36 pages (13 main; 23 SI), 6 figures in main (under review)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Perceived gender inference from names is important for inclusive scientometrics research, yet existing methods perform poorly on non-Western scholars. We address this gap for Chinese names, which appear in two forms, Hanzi and Pinyin, its Romanized form (e.g., Zhang Wei, Li Na). In international bibliographic records, names are often available only in Pinyin. However, a single pinyin name can correspond to multiple distinct hanzi characters with different gender associations, so gender inference from Pinyin alone is intrinsically ambiguous. To address this, we first develop two hanzi models, a regression model that produces a continuous gender score from 0 (male) to 1 (female), and a classification model that outputs one of three labels (\emmale, \emneutral, \emfemale). We train them on a sample of hanzi names from Chinese-language physics publications, rated by 11 native Chinese speakers. On this sample, the models achieve an RMSE of 0.09 and an R ^2 of 0.85 (regression), and macro-AUC of 0.97 and a Cohen’s \kappa of 0.81 (classification), demonstrating high performance that is robust to class imbalance. For pinyin names, we propose a pipeline that aggregates hanzi predictions via transliteration and frequency weighting, together with an ambiguity score that flags names whose gender cannot be resolved from Pinyin alone. Benchmarked against three off-the-shelf tools (Namsor, GPT, and Claude), our models achieve the highest agreement with human annotations for both gender scores and gender labels, in both scripts. Applied to an independent sample of Chinese-named authors in APS journals, our models assign a gender to every name, whereas existing Pinyin-based methods leave between 20% and 100% of names unclassified. These findings demonstrate the importance of hanzi-level information for reliable gender inference of Chinese names. Code and data are publicly available.

[NLP-10] RedDarwin: Evolving Jailbreak Skills against Frontier LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前红队测试（red teaming）在面对前沿大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）安全防护机制持续演进时，缺乏动态适应能力的问题。现有方法多局限于固定攻击流程或对对抗性提示（adversarial prompts）进行搜索，难以有效应对防护策略的更新。其核心解决方案是提出RedDarwin——一个以可执行攻击技能（executable attack skills）为进化单元的代理式框架。该框架将攻击演化从静态提示与固定攻击模式升级为可复用、可组合的技能单元，通过目标模型反馈实现自主修订、组合、执行与选择，使成功攻击机制成为后续进化的构建模块。RedDarwin共生成65个演化后的攻击技能，使44/47个基础攻击的成功率（Attack Success Rate, ASR）显著提升，平均ASR从18.8%增至47.3%。在未参与训练的强拒绝测试集（StrongREJECT）及前沿未见模型上，其表现均优于基线方法；仅需10次目标模型查询，即可在GPT-5.6-Sol上实现100%的攻击成功率，同时在Claude-Sonnet-5和Gemini-3.8-Flash上分别达到92%和80%。分析表明，高效攻击往往源于可复用机制的创新组合，而非单一强大技能的独立作用。这一范式推动了自适应红队测试的发展，并为安全评估与防御机制设计提供了互补价值。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23726
作者: Zhouyuan Ma,Yutao Wu,Hanxun Huang,Xiang Zheng,Yi Liu,Xingjun Ma
机构: Fudan University (复旦大学)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Red teaming must continually adapt as frontier LLM safeguards evolve, yet existing approaches largely search for adversarial prompts or optimize within fixed attack procedures. We observe that even when an attack becomes ineffective, its underlying mechanisms can remain useful and can be revised or recombined to construct stronger attacks. Based on this insight, we introduce RedDarwin, an agentic framework that shifts the unit of jailbreak evolution from prompts and fixed attacks to executable attack skills. RedDarwin consists of 47 reusable base skills and autonomously revises, composes, executes, and selects them using target-model feedback, allowing successful discoveries to become building blocks for subsequent evolution. RedDarwin produces 65 evolved skills, improving 44 of 47 base attacks and increasing their mean attack success rate (ASR) on AdvBench from 18.8% to 47.3%. These evolved skills consistently outperform baselines on the held-out StrongREJECT and frontier LLMs unseen during evolution; with only 10 target-model queries, RedDarwin achieves 100% ASR on GPT-5.6-Sol, 92% on Claude-Sonnet-5, and 80% on Gemini-3.8-Flash. Analysis of the evolution trajectories further shows that strong attacks often emerge from novel combinations of reusable mechanisms rather than from individually dominant ones. We believe this paradigm can accelerate adaptive red teaming and inform stronger safeguards, creating complementary value for both safety evaluation and defense.

[NLP-11] Recognizing Study Lineage Is Not Enough: Over-Crediting Same-Trial Evidence in LLM -Based Medical Verification

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在医学领域大模型验证中，对同一临床试验的多篇发表文献在证据聚合过程中出现的过度归因问题。具体而言，尽管模型在直接识别试验谱系（provenance lineage）任务中表现准确，但在整合多篇相关研究作为证据时，会错误地将同一试验的不同发表视为独立支持性证据，从而导致对研究结论的过度假设。其解决方案的关键在于引入“研究分组指令”（study-grouping instruction），通过显式引导模型在证据聚合阶段识别并合并来自同一试验的多个报告，有效抑制了模型在跨任务中的行为偏差。实验结果表明，该指令可使GPT-5.5在纯谱系家族中的过度归因率从4/5降至0/5，显著缩小了模型在“谱系识别”与“证据聚合”两个阶段之间的行为差距。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23721
作者: Mukand Krishna,Anoushka Harit,Chenghao Xiao,Zhongtian Sun
机构: University of Kent (肯特大学); University of Cambridge (剑桥大学); Shanghai University of Finance and Economics (上海财经大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 20 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables; 8 pages of main content, with references and appendices thereafter

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Publication count is not study count. A model can identify shared trial lineage correctly in a direct task yet over-credit a second publication from the same trial when aggregating evidence. We evaluate this behavior in medical LLM verification using 14 source-audited clinical families and five model conditions. The families span provenance, clinical applicability, result direction, and composition; the provenance families provide the direct lineage tests. Recognition and aggregation are separate stateless calls, and repeated calls assess within-input stability. Across all three original provenance families, GPT-5.5 identifies the independent update in 10/10 recognition calls per family but over-credits the same-trial report in 5/5 separate aggregation calls per family. Selected Qwen3-4B and Ministral-3-8B conditions show the same cross-task contrast. A study-grouping instruction reduces GPT-5.5 over-credit from 4/5 to 0/5 in each later pure-provenance family. Other model conditions show mixed behavior, and rejected outputs limit several comparisons. The results identify a behavioral gap between elicited lineage recognition and evidence aggregation. The code and data artifacts are available at this https URL.

[NLP-12] he Cognitive Cost of LLM Writing: A Reading-Time Comparison with Human Text

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）生成文本与人类撰写文本在阅读认知负荷上的差异问题，特别是这种差异如何影响读者的加工需求。尽管两者在语言特征上的区别已有广泛研究，但其对阅读过程中认知努力的影响仍缺乏深入探讨。为此，研究提出一种基于人类眼动数据训练的模型RoBERTa-RT，用于预测词级阅读时间，从而量化文本处理的认知负荷。关键解决方案在于构建了一个包含496篇人类写作文章及其对应LLM重写版本的配对数据集，并利用该模型对比两类文本的预测阅读时间。结果表明，LLM生成文本虽整体更短、总阅读时间略低，但单个词的预测阅读时间更高，这与更长且不常见的词汇、更高的词汇多样性和更强的上下文可预测性等语言特征相关。从认知视角看，这一发现揭示了机器生成文本可能在降低总体信息量的同时，增加了个体词语的加工难度，即重新分配了阅读的认知负担。因此，研究强调在评估生成式人工智能（Generative AI）内容时，不仅需关注其语言特性，还应考量其对人类认知处理过程的潜在影响。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23715
作者: Kamer Cekini,Elisabetta Biondi,Chiara Boldrini,Andrea Passarella,Marco Conti
机构: IIT-CNR(意大利国家研究委员会智能信息技术研究所); University of Pisa(比萨大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Although linguistic differences between human-written and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated texts have been extensively studied, their implications for the cognitive effort involved in reading remain less explored. In psycholinguistics, reading time is commonly used as an indirect measure of cognitive processing effort. Building on this perspective, we investigate whether human-written texts and their LLM-generated rewrites exhibit differences in predicted reading time that may reflect differences in processing demands for readers. To this end, we introduce RoBERTa-RT, a model trained on human eye-tracking data to predict word-level reading times. We evaluate the model on both internal and external test sets, construct a paired dataset of 496 human-written articles and their LLM-generated rewrites, and apply RoBERTa-RT to compare their predicted reading times. Our findings show that LLM-generated rewrites tend to be shorter and have slightly lower predicted total reading times, while exhibiting higher predicted reading times per word. These differences are associated with systematic linguistic changes, including longer and less frequent words, greater lexical diversity, and higher contextual predictability. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that LLM-generated writing may redistribute reading demands: reducing the amount of text to process while increasing the predicted processing effort associated with individual words. This highlights the importance of considering not only the linguistic characteristics of machine-generated content, but also its potential implications for human cognitive processing.

[NLP-13] GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agent ic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式搜索场景下商品列表优化中语言代理（language agents）难以持续自我改进的问题，即现有方法通常将结构化商品信息视为自由文本处理，导致有效的优化策略隐含于提示词、搜索路径或重写结果中，无法显式积累为可复用的智能记忆。其核心解决方案是提出GLOBE框架，通过构建一个动态演化的“手册”（handbook），以显式、领域特异的行为形式存储优化知识。在每个优化周期中，编辑（Editor）调用相关行为并接收基于排名的反馈，由反思者（Reflector）将其转化为行为更新；为确保实际部署中的可靠性，监督者（Moderator）剔除冗余建议，策展人（Curator）确认有效变更，并禁用有害行为，形成闭环。这一机制将离散的反馈转化为持久、领域聚焦的代理记忆。实验表明，结构化行为优于单一提示优化，且反馈驱动的演化与多层级治理显著提升性能并降低风险。此外，学习到的行为在未见过的商品类别上仍具有效性，证明该框架支持可解释、可迁移的商品优化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23709
作者: Hyunseo Kim,Suil Choe,Sukkyoung So,Daeyeon Yi
机构: LG Electronics( LG 电子), South Korea(韩国)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Accepted to the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models(REALM) at EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.

[NLP-14] VISTA: Steering LLM s with Latent User Values Inferred from a Few Survey Answers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决个性化语言模型（language model）中用户价值观建模与应用的难题：现有方法或依赖任务特定偏好学习，或仅将用户画像置于提示（prompt）中，导致模型难以有效利用用户长期稳定的内在价值倾向。其核心解决方案是提出VISTA（Value-Informed Steering and Targeted Acquisition），通过分析用户部分或完整的调查回答，从隐空间中推断出用户的潜在价值观表征，并借助超网络（hypernetwork）将其映射为针对冻结大语言模型（frozen LLM）的用户专属可控干预机制，实现对回答选项的选择或自由文本生成的精准引导。该方法在不增加提示词数量的前提下，在合成偏好数据集Food2D、世界价值观调查（World Values Survey, WVS）及PrimeX上均达到或超越基于上下文的用户画像表现。为进一步降低用户认知负担，VISTA还引入自适应问卷设计策略，动态选择提问内容并决定停止时机——在WVS上仅需完成6%的题量即可保留94%的完整历史信息收益，显著优于传统自适应测试（最多保留42%）。关键发现表明，主导性的控制方向对应一个可解释的价值轴，能准确定位未见用户的位置。研究结果揭示了一种可部署、面向个体差异的多元对齐（pluralistic alignment）范式，具备实际应用潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23702
作者: Yinuo Xu,Jadie Adams,Brian Hu,Shivani Kumar,David Jurgens,Arslan Basharat
机构: University of Michigan (密歇根大学); Kitware Inc. (Kitware公司)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 8 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Personalizing a language model requires knowing what a person values, which stays largely consistent across tasks. Yet most methods either learn task-specific preferences or place the user’s profile in the prompt, where models struggle to act on it. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Steering and Targeted Acquisition), which infers a latent profile from users’ (full or partial) survey answers, and maps the profile through a hypernetwork to a user-specific steering intervention in a frozen LLM to select answer choices or generate free-text responses. Given the same evidence, VISTA matches or beats in-context profiles on synthetic preferences (Food2D), the World Values Survey (WVS), and PrimeX, without adding prompt tokens. To reduce the cognitive burden of completing full surveys, VISTA also chooses which questions to ask and when to stop: on WVS it stops after 6% of the questionnaire while retaining 94% of the full-history gain, where standard adaptive testing retains at most 42%. The dominant steering direction is an interpretable value axis on which VISTA places unseen users accurately. Our results point toward pluralistic alignment that adapts to individuals at deployable cost.

[NLP-15] Beyond the Benchmark: Conditioning Domains and Failure Modes of Qwen 3-TTS

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语音克隆（Voice Cloning）技术在实际应用中存在的一系列关键问题，包括模型条件化方式不明确、在非朗读语境下的表现未知以及失败模式缺乏系统分析。其核心解决方案是通过全面评估Qwen3-TTS的两种语音克隆接口——上下文学习（In-Context Learning, ICL）与X-Vector——在多种真实场景（如会议对话、情感表达及航空交通管制语音）中的性能表现，并对比Chatterbox、XTTS-v2和F5-TTS等基准模型。研究发现，两种接口各具优势：ICL在参考文本正确时能更精准地复制音色，而X-Vector在语音时序建模上表现更优；但当参考文本存在错误时，ICL性能急剧下降。此外，任务领域解释了四倍于系统选择的方差，表明场景适应性至关重要。尽管Qwen3-TTS在可懂度和音高范围方面领先，但在韵律建模上仍落后于其他模型，且客观指标与人工听感评价结果不一致。值得注意的是，现有防伪造检测机制对Qwen3-TTS的克隆样本误报率与真实录音相当，而在航空交通管制场景下所有系统均失效。该研究揭示了当前语音克隆技术在鲁棒性、泛化能力与安全性方面的局限性，为后续优化提供了实证基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23678
作者: Séverin Baroudi,Yanis Labrak,Petr Motlicek,Hervé Bredin,Ricard Marxer
机构: Institut National de l’Audiovisuel (INA)(法国国家视听研究所); Université Paris Cité (巴黎城市大学); Télécom Paris (巴黎电信学院); Institut Polytechnique LaSalle Beauvais (拉沙尔-博韦理工学院); CNRS (法国国家科学研究中心); LIA (语言与信息分析实验室)

Abstract:Qwen3-TTS reports state-of-the-art zero-shot voice cloning, but its technical report leaves open how the model should be conditioned, how it behaves outside read speech, and how it fails. We characterise its two cloning interfaces, in-context learning (ICL) and X-Vector, against Chatterbox, XTTS-v2 and F5-TTS on read, meeting, emotional and air-traffic-control (ATC) speech, using eighteen objective measures, an LLM judge, a spoofing countermeasure and a listening test. Neither interface dominates: ICL clones timbre more closely from correctly transcribed references, X-Vector clones timing, and ICL degrades sharply when a short reference transcript is wrong. Domain explains four times more variance than system choice. Qwen3-TTS leads on intelligibility and pitch register but trails on prosody, and the objective measures rank systems differently from listeners. An off-the-shelf countermeasure flags its clones no more often than genuine recordings, and on ATC radio it fails for every system. Code and audio are released.

[NLP-16] In Human Memories. Technology Creativity and Self-Determination: An Ethical Proposal

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在当代作曲实践中引发的创作主体性与伦理边界问题，尤其关注其从传统技术工具向具有主动参与性的创作伙伴转变所带来的挑战。其解决方案的关键在于重构作曲家与AI之间的关系：不再将AI视为被动的辅助资源，而是将其视作具有未知潜力的“他者”进行互动探索，在此过程中建立一种伦理导向的共创模式，从而实现技术对创造力的赋能而非替代，体现于弗朗切斯科·维图奇（Francesco Vitucci）《在人类记忆中》（In Human Memories, 2024）一作中，AI不仅作为灵感来源，更成为推动音乐形态生成的核心动力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23651
作者: Francesco Vitucci,Giuseppe Silvi,Francesco Abbrescia,Anthony Di Furia,Francesco Scagliola
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 19 pages, 7 figures. English translation of the article originally published in Italian in Ex Chordis, vol. 3 (2024), pp. 15-38. The Italian original is the version of record

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This research investigates the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in modern compositional practices, with a particular focus on two case studies: Convergence (2020/21) by Alexander Schubert, for String Ensemble and AI System, and In Human Memories (2024) by Francesco Vitucci, for four cellos and one electroacoustic player, whose installation was created by the Electronic Music School of the “N. Piccinni” Conservatory of Bari. The initial historical survey traces the evolving use of technology in composition, revealing how the search for new expressive possibilities has driven the development of technological tools through experimentation. The appearance of AI marks a fundamental shift: no longer just a tool, AI now poses questions and challenges to the composer. Engaging with AI becomes an exploration of an unknown entity, whose full capabilities are still largely undiscovered. This new interaction leads composers to confront AI not merely as a passive resource but as a participant in the creative process, outlining an ethical path to reclaim technology as a creative tool. In Human Memories reflects this dynamic, demonstrating how AI can serve as both inspiration and a driving force in shaping contemporary music.

[NLP-17] rajectory-Triggered Sparse Collaborative Decoding EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中密集辅助解码方法导致目标模型计算与生成过程紧密耦合的问题，从而降低推理效率。其核心解决方案是提出一种稀疏协同解码（sparse collaborative decoding）框架，即由草稿模型生成大部分令牌，仅在需要纠正时调用目标模型进行短片段修正。该方案的关键在于设计一个高效的触发机制以决定何时调用目标模型。研究发现，局部不确定性指标（如熵、负对数似然、logit 间距、top-k 质量及速度特征）作为触发信号表现不佳，预测失败的准确率接近随机水平（AUC 0.50–0.53）。相比之下，基于草稿模型置信度路径的全局轨迹形状特征（aggregate trajectory-shape features）结合轻量级逻辑回归预测器，仅使用草稿正确性标签进行训练，即可实现高达 AUC 0.86 的预测性能，显著提升触发准确性。该方法揭示了触发时机的权衡：早期调用具有更强的引导能力但证据较弱，而晚期调用虽有更强证据但调整空间有限。实验表明，在五个 GSM8K 草稿-目标模型组合上，该在线学习的稀疏协同解码方法相比最优开环调度提升了 5.3 至 20.0 个准确率点；在 MATH-500 上，当早期预测与目标模型能力匹配时可获得 7.0–13.5 点增益，否则性能下降；在 StrategyQA 上亦取得 5.0–8.3 点改进，证明其具备超越算术任务的泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23613
作者: Amit Ranjan Trivedi,Sruthikesh Surineni,Kyong Ho Lee,Mohit Mittal,Steven Li,Rex Hill
机构: University of Illinois Chicago (伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校); Meta
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 17 pages. Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 uncertainty workshop

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Dense assistance methods such as speculative decoding repeatedly verify draft tokens with a target model, keeping target computation coupled to generation. We study sparse collaborative decoding, where a draft model generates most tokens and a target model is invoked only for short corrective segments. The key problem is deciding when to call the target. We show that local uncertainty is a weak trigger: entropy, negative log-likelihood, logit margin, top- k mass, and velocity features give near-chance failure prediction, with AUC 0.50-0.53. In contrast, aggregate trajectory-shape features over the draft confidence path reach AUC 0.86 using a lightweight logistic predictor trained only from draft correctness labels. This induces a trigger-timing tradeoff: early calls have more leverage but weaker evidence, while later calls have stronger evidence but less ability to redirect the trajectory. Used online, learned sparse collaborative decoding improves over the best open-loop schedule by +5.3 to +20.0 accuracy points across five GSM8K draft-target pairs. On MATH-500, it gains 7.0-13.5 points when early prediction and target competence align, but loses when either is weak. On StrategyQA, it improves over open-loop by 5.0-8.3 points, showing transfer beyond arithmetics.

[NLP-18] SIT-Eval: Situation-Based Interactive Turn-by-Turn Evaluation of Conversational Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前对话型人工智能（Conversational AI）评估方法在面对多样化对话场景时的不足，特别是现有对话基准普遍采用静态自然对话，难以覆盖低概率但关键的安全性事件（如罕见情境下的不当行为），导致在实际部署规模下频繁出现失效。其核心挑战在于：如何在保持对话真实性的前提下，实现对复杂情境下模型行为的全面、统计可靠的评估。解决方案的关键在于提出SIT-Eval——一种可调节的情境化评估框架，将理想行为形式化为“情境规则”（if situation is P, follow rules Q），并通过大语言模型（LLM）作为对话对手进行均匀采样的情境模拟，并由具备上下文感知能力的LLM评判器，依据所有适用的情境规则对模型回复进行多维度评分。该评判器通过人工验证的合成黄金对话数据进行验证，确保评估可靠性。实验结果表明，该方法能揭示聚合指标掩盖的细粒度失败模式，揭示各模型在模糊性澄清与苏格拉底式提问等关键能力上的普遍短板。

作者: Ravil Mussabayev,Saveliy Zavertyaev,Dmitriy Parpulov,Andrey Savchenko
机构: Satbayev University (萨特巴耶夫大学); Sber AI Lab (斯贝爾人工智能实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
